text: URGENT P1 for your HL-12 design (HL-26): PostgREST automatically retries SQLSTATE 40001, and research_assisted_order_set_status (bridge line 948) and research_assisted_order_document_complete (line 1034) raise 40001 for DETERMINISTIC refusals, so the retry never ends. Disposable PG 17.6.1.171 + PostgREST v14.13: 10/15 concurrent-verifier pairs left the losing HTTP request hanging; xact_rollback ~6,400/s, CPU pinned, loop continued after client disconnect until PostgREST restart. One document_complete call for a non-pending document: 8,038 rollbacks in 10s, still looping after client gave up. Customer-reachable: service.ts:995-1053 completeDocumentUpload does not check upload_pending before completeDocument, so a double submit loops. Fix: raise a NON-retryable SQLSTATE (e.g. P0001/55000) for CAS/stale refusals and map it to 409 in supabase-repository.ts fail(); idempotent completion; your new quote/payment RPCs must not use 40001 for refusals. Also confirmed on the composed HTTP->service->repository->PostgREST->SQL path: paid ACCEPTED for 'x', 1c vs 10000c, EUR, reused verification id; paid->cancelled without refund evidence; whitespace id -> 500 assisted_order_unavailable (TS/SQL parity gap). Report + reusable harness: docs/review/xenios-health-launch-review-20260930/11_HL12_COMPOSED_QUALIFICATION_afb3aed.md and sql/composed/.
